goal: Add rate limiting with tests, docs, a migration and a CLI flag
note: The hero plan from the demo. No task names a model: routing decides all twelve.

tasks.title: Decide the limiter algorithm and where the state lives
tasks.task: Decide between a fixed-window counter and a sliding-window log for the rate limiter, and say where the counters live (in-process vs shared store). Write the decision down with the trade-offs and pick one.
tasks.acceptance: A short decision note naming the algorithm, the store, and the reason the alternative was rejected.

tasks.title: Implement the limiter core
tasks.task: Implement the rate limiter core in src/limiter/index.ts using the decided algorithm: a pure function that takes a key, a limit, a window and a clock, and returns allow/deny with the remaining budget.
tasks.acceptance: Pure, clock-injected, no I/O; unit-tested at the boundary values.

tasks.title: Wire the limiter into the request pipeline
tasks.task: Add an express middleware in src/middleware/rate-limit.ts that calls the limiter core and returns 429 with Retry-After when the budget is exhausted. Keep the core free of framework types.
tasks.acceptance: Requests over the limit get 429 and Retry-After; under the limit they pass through unchanged.

tasks.title: Add the shared counter store
tasks.task: Implement the counter store behind the interface from the core, with an in-memory implementation for tests and a Redis implementation selected by config.
tasks.acceptance: Both implementations satisfy the same interface tests; the Redis one is skipped when REDIS_URL is unset.

tasks.title: Add the migration for the rate-limit table
tasks.task: Add db/migrations/0031_rate_limit_buckets.sql creating the buckets table with a composite primary key on (key, window_start) and an index on window_start for the cleanup job.
tasks.acceptance: Migration applies cleanly and rolls back; db/schema.sql regenerated.

tasks.title: Add the --rate-limit flag
tasks.task: Add a --rate-limit <n> CLI flag that overrides the configured per-key limit for one process, defaulting to the config value.
tasks.acceptance: --help shows it; an invalid value exits non-zero with a clear message.

tasks.title: Unit-test the limiter at its boundaries
tasks.task: Add unit tests covering exactly-at-limit, one-over-limit, window rollover and clock going backwards.
tasks.acceptance: The four boundary cases are covered and fail if the boundary logic changes.

tasks.title: Integration-test the 429 response
tasks.task: Add an integration test that drives the app over the request pipeline and asserts the 429 status, the Retry-After header and that the counter resets when the window rolls over.
tasks.acceptance: Green locally and in CI; no test depends on wall-clock sleeps longer than one window.

tasks.title: Document rate limiting in the README
tasks.task: Add a README section describing the limiter, the new config keys and the --rate-limit flag, with the default limits.
tasks.acceptance: A reader can configure a limit without reading the source.

tasks.title: Add the changelog entry
tasks.task: Add an entry under Unreleased describing the rate limiter, the new flag and the migration.
tasks.acceptance: Entry present, follows the existing format.

tasks.title: Add the bucket cleanup job
tasks.task: Add a scheduled job that deletes buckets whose window_start is older than the longest configured window, with a test using an injected clock.
tasks.acceptance: Old rows are removed and recent ones are kept; the injected clock makes the test deterministic.

tasks.title: Fix the flaky scheduler test
tasks.task: test/scheduler.test.ts fails about one run in five in CI with a timeout. Work out why and fix it.
tasks.acceptance: The test passes 50 consecutive local runs and no longer depends on real timers.
